results.justification: RFC 9112 §6.1: if both present, CL MUST be ignored; divergent front/back-end framing.

results.justification: RFC 9112 §6.3.4: multiple CL is invalid.

results.justification: RFC 9112 §6.3: CL is 1*DIGIT.

results.description: Signed Content-Length (`+5`).
results.justification: RFC 9112 §6.3: no sign permitted.

results.description: Two separate Transfer-Encoding fields.
results.justification: RFC 9112 §6.1; multiple TE lines invite parser disagreement.

results.description: Empty Transfer-Encoding value.
results.justification: RFC 9112 §6.1: TE is a non-empty coding list.

results.description: Transfer-Encoding: chunked on an HTTP/1.0 request line.
results.justification: RFC 9112 §6.1: chunked is undefined for HTTP/1.0; smuggling via downgrade.

results.description: `chunked` is not the FINAL transfer coding (`chunked, gzip`).
results.justification: RFC 9112 §6.1: chunked MUST be final.

results.description: `chunked` applied twice.
results.justification: RFC 9112 §6.1: chunked appears at most once, final.

results.justification: RFC 9112 §5.1: no whitespace between field-name and colon; a smuggling/desync primitive.
